method_note: The three reductions use the same calibration frames and the same PTC/dark-ladder estimators. Bias/dark subtraction is additive and therefore cancels in a flat-pair difference; the dark-ladder slope is unchanged by the equivalent median-combine operation. The independent pixel-level arithmetic differences, including the IRAF flat-normalisation difference, are reported separately in iraf_preproc_stats.json and Figure 4. Values are therefore identical at the displayed precision rather than forced to look different.
